cues.en: Deneb: Yuto and me, the two of us!
Zeronos: Idiot, like the two of us could handle that!
Birth: He means us. The fighting doctor, Akira Date, has arrived!
Zangetsu Shin: Kouta Kazuraba, leave this to us!
W (Shotaro): Terui... why are you all here...?
Knight: Call us a separate unit.
Knight: Didn't you hear? From that weird red oni?
Momotaros: Who're you calling a weird red oni!!
G3-X: Anyway, leave this to us and go.
Momotaros: ...Fine! You lot, get on board, quick! We're going!!
Shadow Moon: Curse you... all of you! I won't forgive youuuu!!!
